parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left blade and handle assembly of the scissors, made primarily of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides one cutting edge and one handle loop for gripping and applying force during cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot relative to the other blade handle set to perform the cutting action.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right blade and handle assembly of the scissors, made of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the second cutting edge and handle loop, working in conjunction with the left blade to shear materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw joint, moving opposite to the left blade handle set to create a scissoring motion.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: This is the central screw that connects the two blade handle sets, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the pivot point, allowing the two blades to rotate relative to each other while maintaining alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around its axis.
